items.html: *The summary of the matters: that at the beginning of the Atzilut of ZA, he went out from Aba, and was conceived within Ima in the secret of the Hey: Dalet and Vav. And it is a small Vav, for he had only six extremities, after Hochma and Bina, like the manner of the rest of the Sefirot. And in this aspect he is called 'Aba, the father of the fathers,' for from him went out the fathers, who are HGT. And then he had no head, like the Vav within the Hey, which has no head.
